paper_record.title: Graph Neural Networks in the Wilson Loop Representation of Abelian Lattice Gauge Theories
paper_record.abstract: Local gauge structures play a central role in a wide range of condensed matter systems and synthetic quantum platforms, where they emerge as effective descriptions of strongly correlated phases and engineered dynamics. We introduce a gauge-invariant graph neural network (GNN) architecture for Abelian lattice gauge models, in which symmetry is enforced explicitly through local gauge-invariant inputs, such as Wilson loops, and preserved throughout message passing, eliminating redundant gauge degrees of freedom while retaining expressive power. We benchmark the approach on both $\mathbb{Z}_2$ and $\mathrm{U}(1)$ lattice gauge models, achieving accurate predictions of global observables and spatially resolved quantities despite the nonlocal correlations induced by gauge-matter coupling. We further demonstrate that the learned model serves as an efficient surrogate for semiclassical dynamics in $\mathrm{U}(1)$ quantum link models, enabling stable and scalable time evolution without repeated fermionic diagonalization, while faithfully reproducing both local dynamics and statistical correlations. These results establish gauge-invariant message passing as a compact and physically grounded framework for learning and simulating Abelian lattice gauge systems.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 提出一种基于 Wilson 圈表示的图神经网络架构，用于高效模拟阿贝尔格点规范理论及其动力学。
one_sentence_summary.en: Introduces a gauge-invariant GNN architecture based on Wilson loop representations for efficient simulation of Abelian lattice gauge theories and their dynamics.

problem.zh: 解决格点规范理论中局部规范对称性导致的描述冗余，以及规范-物质耦合带来的非定域关联计算难题。
problem.en: Addressing the redundancy caused by local gauge symmetry and the challenge of capturing nonlocal correlations induced by gauge-matter coupling.

approach.zh: 将局部 Wilson 圈作为图神经网络的输入特征，通过消息传递机制在保持规范不变性的同时捕捉格点空间对称性。
approach.en: Using local Wilson loops as input features for a GNN to enforce gauge invariance explicitly while capturing spatial symmetries through message passing.

main_takeaway.zh: 直接在规范不变量空间（Wilson 圈）构建模型，比传统的等变架构更简洁高效，且能作为半经典动力学的可靠代理模型。
main_takeaway.en: Operating directly in the gauge-invariant space (Wilson loops) is more efficient than equivariant architectures and serves as a robust surrogate for semiclassical dynamics.

why_it_matters.zh: 该方法能显著加速量子链路模型和强关联系统的数值模拟，避免了动力学演化中昂贵的费米子对角化计算。
why_it_matters.en: This framework significantly accelerates numerical simulations of quantum link models and strongly correlated systems by bypassing expensive fermionic diagonalizations during dynamics.

reason.zh: 为阿贝尔规范理论提供了一个紧凑且物理动机明确的学习框架，成功应用于复杂的动力学模拟。
reason.en: Provides a compact and physically grounded learning framework for Abelian gauge theories, successfully applied to complex dynamical simulations.

reason.zh: 论文结合了凝聚态物理中的规范场论与先进的机器学习方法，符合该刊的兴趣方向。
reason.en: The paper combines gauge field theory in condensed matter with advanced ML methods, aligning well with the journal's scope.
